g.text: Main reference: style-a.png. Draft, no new artistic confirmation.
Toon ramp: 3steps (80,170,255); skin smooth normals, scenery flat.
Low: both streamed tiles45% density, nearby valleyLOD1, far valleyLOD2.
Two render passes: distant layer1, clearDepth, foreground layer0.
Additive glow uses native144tri mesh; no full-screen Bloom pass.
Colors are sRGB targets; Blender vertex colors exported in linear space.
